subject: Discovery follow-up: Schedule demo / technical deep-dive (FinPath)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@finpath.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finpath.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick follow-up + next steps from today

Hi Laura / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time today - great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Problem: FinPath needs predictable low-latency LLM inference for real-time credit scoring with strong auditability and tenant isolation.
- Priority: security & procurement sign-off, then a technical deep-dive with your SREs and our infra lead.
- Success criteria: <1x100ms median token latency for the main route, SOC2 attestation, and a clear rollout plan for sandbox -> prod.

Next steps I propose:
1) Schedule a 60m technical deep-dive/demo with your platform/SRE and our solutions engineer to walk architecture, quantization, and routing policies.
2) Share a short Mutual Action Plan and SOC2 summary (attached).
3) Loop in security/procurement as needed to close the contract.

Suggested times (PST):
- Tue 3/2 10:00-11:00 or 14:00-15:00
- Wed 3/3 09:00-10:00 or 13:00-14:00

Laura, are any of these work for you? If so I'll loop in our infra lead (Dev) and our security PM (Neha) and send a calendar invite.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf, FinPath_MutualActionPlan.xlsx

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198
redwood.ai

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@finpath.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finpath.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + next steps from today

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the clear recap. Both Tom and I are aligned on the ask. The SOC2 summary looks good at a glance - procurement will want the full attestation but this is a good start.

For the technical session: Wed 3/3 13:00-14:00 PST works best for us. Can you also include a short agenda focused on:
- production architecture + high-availability
- security controls and key management
- performance expectations & benchmarking approach

I'll loop in procurement once we confirm timing so they can review the MAP and flag any contract items early.

Laura
VP, Product | FinPath
laura.chen@finpath.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@finpath.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finpath.com>, procurement@finpath.com
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + next steps from today

Perfect - thanks Laura. Wed 3/3 13:00-14:00 PST is booked on my side. Looping in two folks from our side:

- Dev Patel (Infra / Solutions Engineer) will lead the technical deep-dive and demo the Dedicated deployment patterns and routing/fallback behavior.
- Neha Kapoor (Security PM) will cover auditing, KMS/HSM integrations, and SOC2 artifacts.

Proposed agenda (30-45m demo + 15-30m Q&A/procurement items):
1) 0-10m: brief intro & success criteria (you)
2) 10-40m: infra deep-dive + live demo (Dev)
3) 40-55m: security & compliance (Neha)
4) 55-60m: next steps & mutual action items (Marissa)

Attachments: I've re-attached the SOC2 summary and a draft Mutual Action Plan for procurement to review prior to the call.

Dev / Neha - any additional items you want on the agenda?

I'll send a calendar invite shortly.

Thanks,
Marissa

To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@finpath.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 09:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + next steps from today

Thanks Marissa - Wednesday works for me. Appreciate you looping Dev and Neha in.

A couple quick asks from procurement / legal before the call:
- Can you send a short draft SOW or statement of work (even high-level) so procurement can start internal review?
- Please include any compliance contacts / who signs the SOC2 attestation request.

We can review during the call but procurement prefers to have something in hand beforehand. If you can share a 1-2 page SOW and the contact for SOC2 requests, that will speed things up.

Tom
Head of Platform | FinPath
procurement@finpath.com
